entry.name: Supermium
entry.verified: Supermium (win32ss); binary unsigned, no published checksums checked (preinstalled); driver: chromedriver_win32.zip 2.29 from chromedriver.storage.googleapis.com, unsigned, no checksum file
entry.smoke: fail: with the contract's W3C request (goog:chromeOptions) chromedriver 2.29 ignores the binary ('cannot find Chrome binary'); passes with legacy JSON-wire: 'chromeOptions' key + POST /session/<id>/execute
entry.notes: No official driver newer than 2.29 runs on Vista (2.30+, 109, 122 exit 0xC0000139). 2.29 drives Supermium 122 headless fine over the legacy protocol: UA 'HeadlessChrome/122.0.0.0' (reports Windows NT 10.0), isSecureContext true, crypto.subtle true. Harness needs a legacy path (desiredCapabilities with 'chromeOptions', /execute instead of /execute/sync) to use it. Driven over the DevTools protocol by tests/browsers (protocol: cdp): chromedriver 2.29, the newest that starts on Vista, predates W3C WebDriver.
